aboutData.heading: Our Story

images.alt: Alex and Drew, the two owners of Glass Glow Idaho

paragraphs: We are two lifelong friends who graduated from Rocky Mountain High School and are currently pursuing degrees at Boise State University. We turned our shared passion for cleanliness and sparkling windows into a thriving business.

Our commitment to providing exceptional service, attention to detail, and friendly customer care has earned us a solid reputation in the Treasure Valley. We take great pride in transforming dull, smudged windows into clear, breathtaking views that bring joy and brightness into our clients’ lives.
Whether it's residential or commercial, no job is too big or too small. Let us bring a touch of clarity and brilliance to your world.
